name: Monthly Pre-Bill Assembler

parameters.content:
## Monthly Pre-Bill Assembler

### How it works

**Compile & route (once a month):**
1. On your firm's compile day, pulls every draft pre-bill from Clio and groups them by each matter's responsible attorney.
2. Emails each attorney one message listing every pre-bill they need to review this cycle — matter, client, amount — with a link straight to Clio.

**Nudge laggards (daily, only on specific days):**
3. Checks in on specific days relative to your firm's billing deadline (3 days before, 1 day before, on the deadline, and a few days after) — not every single day, so nobody gets spammed.
4. Re-fetches draft pre-bills from Clio. Anything still in draft has genuinely not been reviewed yet — Clio drops a pre-bill from this list the moment an attorney finalizes it, so the nudge list is always accurate with no extra tracking needed.
5. Attorneys still short of the deadline get a reminder; anyone still outstanding on or after the deadline gets the managing partner looped in directly.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Set CLIO_BASE_URL and connect the Clio OAuth2 credential (reuse if already deployed for PAC-18/20/55/57/58/59).
- [ ] Set FIRM_BILLING_DEADLINE_DAY to the day of the month pre-bills must be finalized by (pick 28 or earlier — days above 28 don't exist in every month).
- [ ] Set FIRM_NAME, FIRM_FROM_EMAIL, FIRM_PARTNER_EMAIL, GUARDRAIL_WORKFLOW_ID, and optionally FIRM_CLIO_BILLING_URL.
- [ ] In Clio, confirm every matter has a responsible attorney assigned with a valid email — matters without one are silently excluded (nobody to email).
- [ ] Connect the SMTP credential.

### Customization

Adjust the compile-day cron on 'Monthly Pre-Bill Compile Trigger' to run a few days before your deadline. Edit the nudge offsets directly in 'Compute Nudge Tier For Today' if your firm wants a different cadence.

## Compile and route

Once a month, fetches every draft pre-bill from Clio, groups them by responsible attorney, and emails each attorney their own review list.

## Nudge trigger and window check

Runs daily but only takes action on specific days relative to the firm's billing deadline — 3 days before, 1 day before, on the deadline, and a couple of follow-ups after. Every other day is a no-op, so this never spams anyone.

## Re-check outstanding pre-bills

Re-fetches draft pre-bills the same way the compile step did. Anything still in draft state genuinely hasn't been reviewed — Clio removes a pre-bill from this list the moment it's finalized, so no separate tracking is needed.

## Reminder vs. partner escalation

Attorneys still ahead of the deadline get a reminder email. Anyone still outstanding on or after the deadline routes to the managing partner instead — same escalation shape as the Invoice Reminder Ladder (PAC-18).

nodes.name: Monthly Pre-Bill Compile Trigger
nodes.notes:
Fires once a month, on the 25th at 8am (n8n server timezone) by default. Set this a few days before FIRM_BILLING_DEADLINE_DAY so attorneys have time to review before the nudge phase kicks in.

This is the only thing that starts a compile run — nothing else in this half of the workflow fires on its own.

nodes.name: Fetch Draft Pre-Bills From Clio
nodes.notes:
Pulls every draft pre-bill in one request. Same bills.json endpoint and 'status' query parameter as the Invoice Reminder Ladder (PAC-18), which already confirmed this works against a live Clio account — 'draft' as the specific status value follows the same convention as PAC-18's 'overdue' but hasn't itself been independently confirmed live, so check your first real run's output matches what you see in Clio's own pre-bill list.

Credential: same Clio OAuth2 credential as PAC-18/20/55/57/58/59 — reuse it if already deployed.

Returns up to 200 pre-bills per run. If your firm regularly has more in draft at once, add a loop over the 'page' parameter.

nodes.name: Group Pre-Bills By Attorney
nodes.notes: Bills whose matter has no responsible attorney (or no email on file) are counted in unassigned_count but excluded from attorney_groups — there's nobody to send them to. Check unassigned_count in execution history periodically; a nonzero value means a matter in Clio needs a responsible attorney assigned.

nodes.name: If Has Draft Pre-Bills
nodes.notes:
Yes (at least one attorney has draft pre-bills) → route review emails.
No (nothing in draft — an unusually clean cycle, or nothing billed yet) → route to Skip.

nodes.name: Skip No Pre-Bills To Compile
nodes.notes: No draft pre-bills found this cycle — nothing to route. No emails sent.

nodes.name: Split Into One Item Per Attorney
nodes.notes: Fans out into one item per attorney with draft pre-bills — everything downstream through the send step processes one attorney's review bundle at a time.

nodes.name: Build Pre-Bill Review Email
nodes.notes:
Builds one review email per attorney listing every draft pre-bill assigned to them, with a direct link into Clio's billing view. This is an internal firm email — no client is ever contacted by this workflow.

FIRM_CLIO_BILLING_URL is optional — falls back to a generic Clio drafts URL if unset.

nodes.name: Log Pre-Bill Routing To Compliance
nodes.notes:
Logs the routing event to the OPS1 compliance audit sheet via the Bar-Compliance Guardrail (NTC-33). This is internal record-keeping, not a message to a client — opt-out checking doesn't apply here, same as PAC-18's partner escalation and PAC-59/60's internal notifications.

The guardrail workflow ID is read from the GUARDRAIL_WORKFLOW_ID n8n Variable.

nodes.name: Send Pre-Bill Review Email To Attorney
nodes.notes:
Delivers the review bundle to the attorney. Reads all fields explicitly from 'Build Pre-Bill Review Email' rather than $json — the guardrail call immediately upstream replaced the item's json with its own response.

Credential: project → Credentials tab → New → search SMTP → save as 'Email account (SMTP)'.

nodes.name: Daily Pre-Bill Nudge Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires every day at 8am (n8n server timezone) — but the very next node decides whether today is actually a nudge day, so most runs do nothing. Running daily (not just on the known offsets) means the correct day is never missed even if the server restarts or a run is delayed.

nodes.name: Compute Nudge Tier For Today
nodes.notes: Edit the offsets directly in this node's code to change the nudge cadence — e.g. add a -14 entry for a second monthly check-in, or remove the -7 entry if one partner escalation is enough. 'overdue' tier routes to the managing partner instead of the attorney; 'reminder'/'urgent' go to the attorney directly.

nodes.name: If Nudge Tier Is Active Today
nodes.notes:
Yes (today matches one of the configured offsets) → check Clio for outstanding pre-bills.
No (any other day) → route to Skip without even calling the Clio API.

nodes.name: Skip Not A Nudge Day
nodes.notes: Today doesn't match a configured nudge offset — nothing to check, no API call made. Expected for most days of the month.

nodes.name: Fetch Outstanding Draft Pre-Bills
nodes.notes:
Same query as the compile step's 'Fetch Draft Pre-Bills From Clio' — re-run fresh each nudge day. Anything still in draft genuinely hasn't been finalized yet; Clio drops a pre-bill from this list the instant it's reviewed and finalized, so this list is always accurate without this workflow needing to track review state itself.

Same Clio OAuth2 credential as the compile step.

nodes.name: Group Outstanding Pre-Bills By Attorney
nodes.notes: Same grouping as the compile step, plus tier and days_until_deadline carried forward explicitly from 'Compute Nudge Tier For Today' by node reference, since the Clio API call immediately upstream replaced the item's json. Unassigned bills (no responsible attorney email) are excluded here too, same as the compile step.

nodes.name: If Has Outstanding Pre-Bills
nodes.notes:
Yes (someone still has draft pre-bills on a nudge day) → send reminders/escalations.
No (everything was finalized before this check ran — the good outcome) → route to Skip.

nodes.name: Skip No Outstanding Pre-Bills
nodes.notes: Every pre-bill was finalized before this nudge check ran. No reminders needed — this is the workflow working as intended, not a failure to detect anything.

const { attorney_groups, has_draft_prebills, ...meta } = $input.first().json;
return attorney_groups.map(g => ({ json: { ...meta, ...g } }));

nodes.name: Split Outstanding Into One Item Per Attorney
nodes.notes: Fans out into one item per attorney still holding draft pre-bills, carrying the shared tier/days_until_deadline forward onto every item.

nodes.name: If Tier Is Overdue
nodes.notes:
Yes (today is the deadline or a follow-up day past it) → escalate straight to the managing partner instead of nudging the attorney again.
No ('reminder' or 'urgent' tier, still ahead of the deadline) → send the attorney a direct reminder.

nodes.name: Build Partner Escalation For Laggard
nodes.notes: Builds the escalation email for the managing partner — same 'internal email, bypass client-facing guardrail approval' pattern as PAC-18's 60-day overdue-invoice escalation. FIRM_PARTNER_EMAIL reuses the same n8n Variable PAC-18 already uses, so if that template is deployed this needs no new configuration.

nodes.name: Log Escalation To Compliance
nodes.notes: Logs the escalation to the OPS1 compliance audit sheet — internal record-keeping only, same as the compile step's logging call.

nodes.name: Send Partner Escalation Email
nodes.notes:
Delivers the escalation to the managing partner. Reads all fields explicitly from 'Build Partner Escalation For Laggard' — the guardrail call immediately upstream replaced the item's json.

Credential: same 'Email account (SMTP)' credential as the compile step.

nodes.name: Build Attorney Nudge Email
nodes.notes: Builds the reminder email for 'reminder' (3 days out) and 'urgent' (1 day out) tiers — tone escalates slightly between the two, same idea as PAC-18's day1→day30 tone ladder.

nodes.name: Log Nudge To Compliance
nodes.notes: Logs the nudge to the OPS1 compliance audit sheet — internal record-keeping only, same as the compile step's logging call.

nodes.name: Send Attorney Nudge Email
nodes.notes:
Delivers the reminder to the attorney directly. Reads all fields explicitly from 'Build Attorney Nudge Email' — the guardrail call immediately upstream replaced the item's json.

Credential: same 'Email account (SMTP)' credential as the rest of this workflow.

description: Compiles every draft pre-bill in Clio once a month, groups them by responsible attorney, and routes each attorney a single review email with a link straight into Clio. A separate daily check (active only on specific days relative to the firm's billing deadline) re-fetches outstanding drafts and nudges attorneys still behind, escalating straight to the managing partner once the deadline is reached or passed. Replaces the manual chasing that stalls the monthly billing cycle. Logs every routing and every escalation to the OPS1 compliance audit sheet — entirely internal, no client is ever contacted.
